### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **11** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**8** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`  _(via meta.publishItem (sdk, the route ledger binds it to POST /api/v1/meta/:type/:name/publish, selected by route anchor /:type/:name/publish), publishItem (sdk, the bare tail of client method meta.publishItem, bound to POST /api/v1/meta/:type/:name/publish))_
- `content/docs/api/metadata-api.mdx`  _(via /:type/:name/publish (route, bridged from symbol draftVersion — its route source's handler names it; bridged from symbol parentVersion — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`  _(via parentVersion (symbol, a field of type PublishMetaItemRequest, an authorable key of api/PublishMetaItemRequest), /:type/:name/publish (route, bridged from symbol draftVersion — its route source's handler names it; bridged from symbol parentVersion — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/currency.mdx`  _(via /:type/:name/publish (route, bridged from symbol draftVersion — its route source's handler names it; bridged from symbol parentVersion — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`  _(via /:type/:name/publish (route, bridged from symbol draftVersion — its route source's handler names it; bridged from symbol parentVersion — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/kernel/contracts/metadata-service.mdx`  _(via /:type/:name/publish (route, bridged from symbol draftVersion — its route source's handler names it; bridged from symbol parentVersion — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`  _(via registerMetaItemHistoryRoutes (symbol, a top-level function))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/error-handling.mdx`  _(via /:type/:name/publish (route, bridged from symbol draftVersion — its route source's handler names it; bridged from symbol parentVersion — its route source's handler names it))_

⛔ **4** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via /:type/:name/publish (route, bridged from symbol draftVersion — its route source's handler names it; bridged from symbol parentVersion — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via /:type/:name/publish (route, bridged from symbol draftVersion — its route source's handler names it; bridged from symbol parentVersion — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-2.mdx`  _(via /:type/:name/publish (route, bridged from symbol draftVersion — its route source's handler names it; bridged from symbol parentVersion — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-4.mdx`  _(via /:type/:name/publish (route, bridged from symbol draftVersion — its route source's handler names it; bridged from symbol parentVersion — its route source's handler names it))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `VALIDATION_ERROR (literal, 38 pages)`
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **180** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a89a01239b31e735e4754ad8c45be9e898c82e18` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `29dfd08dbbbbe6cc626866d906fc6008e3e6b893` — the merge of head `5b332e94602b797bdaf9d06ec9e8f8118833ab14` into base `a89a01239b31e735e4754ad8c45be9e898c82e18`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 29dfd08dbbbbe6cc626866d906fc6008e3e6b893 && git checkout 29dfd08dbbbbe6cc626866d906fc6008e3e6b893
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin a89a01239b31e735e4754ad8c45be9e898c82e18 5b332e94602b797bdaf9d06ec9e8f8118833ab14 && git checkout -B drift-repro a89a01239b31e735e4754ad8c45be9e898c82e18 && git merge --no-ff 5b332e94602b797bdaf9d06ec9e8f8118833ab14

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a89a01239b31e735e4754ad8c45be9e898c82e18
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs a89a01239b31e735e4754ad8c45be9e898c82e18` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8eee7080331c7d1a6c47c4dbb1b7369660cb94a2`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts (the one `hits` path; packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json is a generated shard the face reader does not count) + packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-and-publish.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-routes.ts, ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts, and the ruling's first consumers ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/runtime-metadata-persistence.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RuntimeDraftBar.tsx
Security-touching: no
Rule-change-verified: none

Read: card #36350 with all ten comments (ruling record 7168616260, reports 7164597391 and 7179271525), ruling 7058616478 on #35955, the PR body, its 26-file list, and the net diff against `main` (merge base 80da0864). Check-runs on the head, read at 2026-11-26T01:25Z: 70 runs, 60 success, 9 skipped, 1 failure (`Check Changeset`), none pending.

Two must-fix findings (M1, M2), three should-fix (S1 to S3), five nits. The door itself holds: I could not make it publish a draft the caller did not pin.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`draftVersion` on `PublishMetaItemRequestSchema`** (`z.string().optional()`): right. One optional member, sent in the body beside `message`, as ruling item 1 words it. Absent stays unpinned. The schema refuses `null` and non-strings, which is right: the member is a token only, and a publish has nothing to assert about "no draft".
- **`parentVersion`**: meaning unchanged, right (ruling item 2). Its describe gains one clause pointing at `draftVersion`. The harness pins that a draft token sent as `If-Match` still answers the active row's refusal.
- **REST door, `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` on a present non-string**: right. It agrees with the schema and keeps a malformed pin from being read as no pin. It sits after the capability and walled-catalog gates. Strictly, a body `{"draftVersion": 42}` was ignored before and is refused now. No sender of that key existed, and the sibling member was declared widening on the same shape (`.changeset/36601-published-layer-version-pin.md`), so `Clause-②: yes (widening)` holds.
- **`409 METADATA_CONFLICT`, `currentVersion` = the draft's current token**: right, the ruling's words. `currentVersion: null` for a pinned draft that is no longer pending is derived, not ruled. It is right, but it changes what `currentVersion` means on this door and the published text did not move with it: S1.
- **`Metadata-protocol`**: wrong. The diff moves `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` (`api/PublishMetaItemRequest:draftVersion`), which is `added`, not `none`: M1.
- **The implementation's request type**: not derived. The public `publishMetaItem` request type did not gain the member: S2.

### ② Semver level

M1 (must-fix) — `Check Changeset` is red on this head, and it is right. The PR body and all five changesets declare `Metadata-protocol: none`, and `@objectstack/spec` is graded `patch`. The gate reads the moved `authorable-surface/api.json` shard as an authorable key added and asks for `Metadata-protocol: added` with at least `minor` on the package that carries it. The sibling pin on this same schema did exactly that: `36601-published-layer-version-pin.md` declares `added`, `@objectstack/spec` `minor`, the others `patch`. Fix: `Metadata-protocol: added` on the PR body and in each changeset, and `36350-publish-draft-pin-spec.md` to `minor`. The baseline is not edited.

The rest of ② holds. Every published package the diff touches has a changeset: spec, metadata-protocol, rest, data-objectstack, and app-shell with console. `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is on the PR body and all five. No breaking marker is owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev open question (7179271525): the refused Save answers `'pending-draft'`.** Answered: option A stands for a moved draft. Ruling 7058616478: when the view has an unpublished draft, "Save does not publish that draft on someone's behalf: it says so and points to the view settings to publish or discard it first; the buttons stay." After the refusal the view does have such a draft, holding the other writer's change, and `'pending-draft'` is the answer that says so. Not discarding it is required by the same sentence. One arm does not fit, S3.
- S3 (should-fix) — `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts:643` answers `'pending-draft'` for every publish `METADATA_CONFLICT`, including `currentVersion: null`, where the pinned draft was published or discarded by someone else inside the window. No draft is pending then, so the author is sent to the view settings to review a draft that is not there, and if it was discarded their change is gone with no word. The envelope tells the two apart. For `null`, rethrow the refusal (the dev's option B) and keep `'pending-draft'` for a moved draft.
- **Out-of-scope finding (7179271525): eight other draft-then-publish call sites, in six files, send no `draftVersion`.** It does not touch the contract. The member is opt-in by ruling, absent is unpinned as before, and item 3 named four callers. The seat carries it to a close-out card. `@objectstack/client`'s `publishItem` belongs on that list too: it can state neither pin (read, not reviewed). The PR's acceptance notes do not carry the finding (N5).
- **PR acceptance note, "no current host passes `savedSignal`"**: false on the tree, and it covers a gap in ruling item 3: M2.
- **Ruling record's execution parameter `Metadata-protocol: none`**: contradicted by the gate (M1). The maintainer's word was 「A1」; the parameter was the seat's prediction beside it. The seat corrects it on the card, as 7168644634 corrected another line. Nothing to escalate.
- **Dev's two NOT MEASURED gates and the app-shell suite not re-run after the last commit**: answered by CI. `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, the other lint families, `Test Core` 10/10 and `Test UI` 16/16 are green on this head.
- **First report's confidence gap, two pins on one request**: accepted by the ruling. What is left is a describe gap, N2.
- **SQL push-down**: no finding. The server adds no query; the pin is judged on the draft row the promotion already read. Client side, `updateView` now makes its reads in sequence, which is ordering, not a join.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`** — the member holds against ruling items 1 and 2 and against its first consumers: the REST door reads exactly this member and `MetadataClient.publish` sends it.

S1 (should-fix) — published contract text the diff leaves false.
- `MetadataConflictErrorSchema` (`protocol.zod.ts:1539`, the schema the new harness parses the refusal with). Its `currentVersion` describe says "Send it as `If-Match` to overwrite deliberately (or `If-None-Match: *` when it is `null`)", and its docblock lists the causes as `If-Match`, `If-None-Match: *` or a lost race. On a draft-pin refusal the token is the draft's. Sent as `If-Match` on this door it is refused again, the mistake the harness pins. `null` there means no draft is pending, not "assert no active row". Name the draft pin: the token goes back as `draftVersion`, and `null` means there is nothing to publish.
- `packages/spec/src/api/plugin-rest-api.zod.ts:944-962`, the publish route's declaration. Its `description` gives the 409 one cause, "the published row advanced while the draft was held". Its comment says the body's "only read key is `message`" and "the route cannot 400 a malformed body". Both are false at this head. The file is outside the diff, but this diff is what falsifies it.

**`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-and-publish.ts`** — agrees with the contract. Probes:
- **Order.** The pin is judged on the draft row read under the resolved package key and member, straight after that read and before the slot, ownership, registration and authoring gates. A moved draft answers the conflict, never a rule verdict on someone else's body. The address, lock, draftable and named-base refusals come first, as they do for the active-row pin.
- **Held through the write.** The same row's hash is `expectedDraftHash`. `repo.promoteDraft` re-reads the draft, refuses another hash before the put, and drains by the promoted hash. A draft saved after the gate is neither promoted nor drained.
- **Draft gone.** Before the gate's read: 409 with `currentVersion: null`, pinned by the harness. Between the gate and the write: the store's own conflict or `NO_DRAFT`. Nothing is promoted either way.
- **Token.** `storedParentForToken` compares in keyed form. An empty string, a raw stored hash, a stale token and a token keyed before a restart are all refused, never read as no pin. The token is content-addressed, like `parentVersion`: one minted for another package, member or address matches only a byte-identical draft at the address this publish resolves, which promotes exactly the content the caller pinned.
- **Both pins.** Draft first, then active; either refuses, and the harness pins the split.
- **Audit.** One `denied` / `metadata_conflict` row rides the error and is written by `publishMetaItemUnaudited`'s catch, as for the two existing conflicts. The shared helper keeps their text and the first-write hint. Read, not pinned: N3.
- The package publish states no pin and is unchanged.

**`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`**

S2 (should-fix) — the member is added to the private `promoteDraftForPublish` parameter only. `PublishMetaItemRequest` (`protocol-door-requests.ts:39-96`), the type of the public `publishMetaItem`, declares neither `draftVersion` nor `parentVersion`. The pin reaches the promotion through the untyped spread in `publishMetaItemUnaudited`. A typed in-process caller cannot state it, and a later edit that picks members instead of spreading drops the pin and publishes unpinned. That file's own comment on `packageId` records this hazard, and the spec schema's docblock says it mirrors the implementation's type member for member. Declare `draftVersion` there. `parentVersion` is the same one-line gap and predates this PR.

**`packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-routes.ts`** — agrees with the contract. The member is read beside `message`, refused 400 when present and not a string, forwarded only as a string, and the `If-Match` mapping is untouched. A body the Hono transport cannot read as JSON is refused when the handler reads it, so a pin is not dropped that way.

**`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts`** — agrees. The key is sent only when stated, and may ride beside `ifMatch` or `ifNoneMatch`.

**`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`** — holds ruling item 3 for `updateView`. The pin comes from the strict draft read taken before the layers, so it is never newer than the body merged. No draft seen pins `If-None-Match: *`. A 409 throws; nothing is merged over an unread body.

**`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/runtime-metadata-persistence.ts`** — Save passes its own receipt's version, and each call mints its own token, so no stale token is re-sent on a retry. One arm: S3.

**`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RuntimeDraftBar.tsx`**

M2 (must-fix) — ruling item 3 is not met on the draft bar's main path. Item 3: the bar's Publish "passes the draft token it showed, which closes the dev's out-of-scope finding on that caller". Line 151 clears the shown version when `savedSignal` bumps, and the Publish then goes unpinned. `ViewConfigPanel.tsx:500` passes `savedSignal` and `:390` bumps it on every landed save. That panel is the view settings, where ruling 7058616478 sends the author to publish or discard. So: A saves in view settings, B's Rename lands through `updateView` (it reads A's draft, writes pinned, is accepted), A presses Publish, and B's unreviewed rename goes live. That is the window report 7164597391 named on this caller. The pin holds only when the bar opened on an existing draft and the panel never saved. Fix: after the host's own save, pin the Publish to that save's receipt version, which the panel's `useDraftSaveGuard` already holds, as Save to this view does with its receipt. A blind re-read is not the fix: after B's write it would pin B's draft, which the panel never showed. `RuntimeDraftBar.test.tsx:211` pins the unpinned behaviour and changes with it. Correct the PR body sentence.

Nits:
- N1 (nit) — at the protocol, an off-type `draftVersion: null` from an in-process caller passes `storedParentForToken` (it returns for `null`) and publishes unpinned. The REST door refuses `null`, and it is the only caller. A `typeof` guard at the pin closes it.
- N2 (nit) — the `draftVersion` describe says the two pins "may be sent together" but not that the draft is judged first. A request stale on both learns only the draft's token. An address refusal also precedes the pin: no draft at the address while another package holds one answers `404 NO_DRAFT`, not `409` with `null`.
- N3 (nit) — the protocol changeset claims the conflict audit row; no test in the diff asserts it. The harness already registers the audit object.
- N4 (nit) — after a refused Publish the bar keeps its stale token, so a second click is refused again until the panel is reopened. That is the safe direction, but the PR body's 「可直接再次操作」 is not true for the bar.
- N5 (nit) — the out-of-scope finding is on the card, not in the PR's acceptance notes.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-36350-view-draft-publish-pin`
Reviewed-by: `session_012MmDsSBHy5paNUz6zke9Re`

**VERDICT: FAIL**
